description: Thalura regulation digest-cache hard-gate plus the advisory setup-route gate and the fan-out deny gate. Host-executed cache hooks that the firewall read loop can no longer skip. Put-side persists each section's digest on the firewall's completion — PostToolUse-on-Agent (primary, carries tool_input+tool_response) AND SubagentStop (backup, the structural boundary). Get-side pre-loads a cached digest on the next firewall dispatch — PreToolUse-on-Agent. The fan-out gate co-binds on PreToolUse-on-Agent and DENIES a firewall dispatch that hands more than one document to a single reader (>=2 first-line document_id: keys), returning a corrective re-dispatch reason before any read cost is paid. The setup-route gate re-asserts the setup-vs-task routing decision on every prompt — UserPromptSubmit — as an ADVISORY injection only: on a not-yet-initialized or ambiguous workspace it injects a routing directive, and on a resolved workspace it emits nothing. It NEVER blocks a turn and degrades to the retained startup prose, so a non-steering result is a clean no-regression. Every binding carries a host timeout (the guaranteed hang ceiling) and is FAIL-OPEN: any error path is a no-op (exit 0), so a misbehaving hook never breaks, stalls, or degrades a teacher session.
